property_summary: In the reference C, setL1BlockValues never writes any state, so number() remains 0 after any call; the mutant stores _number, so for the depositor account (address(0)) with nonzero _number the assertion c.number()==0 fails.
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _number into the state variable number after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public number() getter.
